scope: USB debug status and startup diagnostics; not operational BLE/radio protocol
state_changes: Only startup-diagnostic run/results in RAM. No reset, provisioning, storage initialization, configuration or flash command.

self_tests.execution: One check or all, fail fast; no concurrency; unavailable is not success. Running diagnostics survives USB disconnect. A new run replaces the previous result snapshot; run_id identifies it. Startup outcome remains latched.
self_tests.clock: Unsigned 32-bit elapsed milliseconds; advancing-clock check cannot detect a completely stopped system clock without an independent watchdog.
self_tests.display_init: Only scheduled initialization command completion; no panel readback or physical-health claim. Individual execution checks completion and does not reset the panel.
self_tests.startup: Manual runs return tests_busy until the initial display sequence settles. tests reads the current snapshot without starting a run.

button.scope: Read-only GPIO42 USER candidate, independent of USB host; physical mapping pending
button.held_ms: From debounced press; zero when released. last_hold_ms retained until next release. Unsigned32 wrapping clock; counters modulo2^32; RAM resets on reboot.
button.actions: None: no pairing, reset, provisioning or storage writes. GPIO11 remains TFT CS.
